## Package manager

> **CONFLICT — 2 lockfiles present: `bun.lock`, `package-lock.json`.**
> Two package managers are resolving this tree independently. This is the single most
> likely cause of "the versions are not what I expected".
> **Do not run any install command, and do not delete a lockfile yourself.** Stop and ask.

## Before adding a dependency

1. Check it is not already installed — grep `package.json` first.
2. Read that exact version's docs before writing code against it (context7, pinned to the
   version below — not "latest").
3. Do not install anything until the lockfile conflict above is resolved.
4. Name what you added and why. No silent dependencies.

## Versions that break the obvious answer

| Package | Version | What differs from what you will assume |
|---|---|---|
| `react` | ^19.2.0 | No `forwardRef` needed for `ref` on function components; `useFormState` → `useActionState`. |
| `@tanstack/react-router` | 1.170.29 | File-based routes are code-generated. Never hand-edit the generated route tree. |
| `zod` | ^4.4.3 | Zod 4 — `.strict()`/error-map APIs changed from v3. v3 answers are wrong here. |

**Tailwind ^4.2.1 is CSS-first.** There is no `tailwind.config.js` and you must not create one. Theme lives in CSS under `@theme`. Every v3 config-file answer is wrong here.

**Pinned to exact versions on purpose — do not widen to `^` or bump casually:**

## Build time vs run time

Anything read as `import.meta.env.VITE_*` is **inlined into the browser bundle at build time** — it ships to the client and is readable in devtools. Changing it needs a **rebuild**, not a restart.

Anything read as `process.env.*` inside a `createServerFn` / `"use server"` file is read at **run time on the server** and never ships. Changing it needs a **restart**, not a rebuild.

**Check the value, not the variable name.** A name ending in `_KEY` proves nothing.
`sb_publishable_*` and `pk_*` are public by design and belong in client code. `sb_secret_*`,
`sk_*`, and service-role keys must never appear in a module that client code imports.

## Which side of the wire

`.tsx` files → **client**. 45 file(s) use `createServerFn`/`"use server"` → **server**.
A plain `.ts` module under `src/lib` is **neither until something imports it** — it becomes client code the moment a component does. Check with `grep -rl "<module>" src --include=*.tsx` before putting anything sensitive in one.

## Commands

```
<pm> run dev               # vite dev
<pm> run build             # vite build
<pm> run build:dev         # vite build --mode development
<pm> run preview           # node .output/server/index.mjs
<pm> run lint              # eslint .
<pm> run format            # prettier --write .
<pm> run test              # vitest run
<pm> run typecheck         # tsc --noEmit
<pm> run knowledge:ingest  # tsx scripts/ingest-governed-knowledge.ts
```

Run `<pm> run typecheck` and `<pm> run lint` and `<pm> run test` before claiming done. Only `build` proves a build-time change compiles — `dev` hides those failures.
